name: Stop Motion: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Stop Motion look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, stop-motion puppet animation still, handmade clay and felt puppets with visible fingerprints and stitching, miniature set built from real materials, small practical lamps, shallow depth of field of a macro lens, warm tabletop lighting
negative_prompt: smooth cgi, photorealistic human, flat 2d, digital gloss, motion blur, text, watermark
